hero.description: I engineer scalable, high-performance web applications using modern technologies. Passionate about clean code, intuitive UI/UX, and solving complex problems.

paragraphs: I am a frontend developer based in South Delhi, specializing in building responsive and dynamic web applications. My journey started with a deep curiosity for how users interact with the web, driving me to master the fundamentals of UI architecture.

Today, I leverage modern tools like React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS to engineer performant, scalable solutions. I thrive in collaborative environments, constantly pushing myself to write cleaner code and deliver exceptional user experiences. Ultimately, my goal is to evolve into a versatile full-stack engineer.
